Create SIXTEEN complete articulated poses of the SAME creature facing RIGHT (opposite reference), same body size and elevated three-quarter side camera. Row1: relaxed wings half open feet lightly down; breathing/alert head raised wings relaxed differently; flying strong wings upstroke legs tucked; flying downstroke wings below body legs trailing. Row2: flight passing wings horizontal; melee anticipation neck pulled back talons cocked; forward hooked beak jab talons reaching; defense wings folded protecting bronze chest censer. Row3: ranged charge chest censer bright head raised wings drawn inward; ranged release chest forward beak open wings fanned out, no detached projectile; ranged recoil neck pulled back censer dimming wings back; ranged recovery settles with wings half open. Row4: hit recoil head averted wings uneven; dying wings buckling body falling feet slack; falling onto SIDE with folded wings and limp neck; final DEAD bird resting on side, neck and beak flat, collapsed wings, limp talons/tail, censer and ember markings unlit, no smoke. No blood. Every pose genuinely redrawn with visible joint articulation, not rotated/resized copies. Detailed painterly original raster matching reference. True transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, shadows, floor, scenery, text, labels, grid, panel lines, detached smoke clouds, haze, loose sparks or exterior glow. Original art only.
